column3: Hired Thief
Thief Chief
Hired Thief
Imil is quiet today...\nBut the lighthouse is\nstill dark.{end_wait}
Megan and Justin can\nmanage for a little while.\nI needed to clear my head.{end_wait}
There she is. Blue hair,\nhealer's robes. Don't let\nher get back to Imil.{page_break}Move in.{end_wait}
You're blocking the road.\nIs something wrong?{end_wait}
Not for us. Come quietly\nand we'll keep it that way.{end_wait}
Then put your knives\naway. I'm not coming\nwith you.{end_wait}
Three of you... beaten\nby a healer? Useless.{end_wait}
Keep her there, boy.\nThis won't take long.{end_wait}
Your men are beaten.\nYou can still walk away.{end_wait}
I've come too far to\nturn back now.{end_wait}
Who sent you?{end_wait}
Nobody. We heard you\nhad medicines we could\nsell. That's all.{end_wait}
You didn't ask for any.\nYou came straight for me.\nWho told you where to wait?{end_wait}
We watched the village.\nWe knew you'd take\nthis road.{end_wait}
The girl who hired us\nsaid you'd be alone.\nThat's all I know.{end_wait}
What girl?{end_wait}
Red hair. Burnt clothes.\nOne of her eyes glowed.{end_wait}
She looked at us like\nwe'd already failed.{end_wait}
I don't know who she is.\nBut Imil's suffered enough.\nI won't allow this again.{end_wait}
If I see you again,\nyou won't walk away\nnext time. Now go.{end_wait}
All right! We're going!{end_wait}
A red-haired girl...\nI need to warn Megan\nand Justin.{end_wait}
